OpenAI Releases New Astra AI Model After Scrapping Prior Update

OpenAI has released a new version of its advanced Astra artificial intelligence model, nearly two months after abandoning a previous update to implement stronger safeguards. The company's move comes as competitors like Microsoft are also unveiling new AI models for coding and cybersecurity, intensifying competition in the AI sector.
